en.mulla-asgharali-m-m-jaffer: 6. He said: Abul Hasan ‘Ali ibn Khalid al-Maraghi reported to me from al-Qasim Ibn Muhammad al-Dallal, who reported from Ismail ibn Muhammad al-Muzni, who reported from Uthman ibn Sa'id, who reported from ‘Ali ibn Ghurab, from Musa ibn Qais al-Hadhrami, from Salama ibn Kuhail, from Ayadh ibn Ayadh, from his father, who said:

Once ‘Ali ibn Abi Talib (a.s.) passed by a group of people among whom was Salman, may Allah bless him with mercy. So Salman told them: "Be attached to this man (i.e. ‘Ali) for no one else will inform you of the intimate things about your Prophet except he."
